title: SMTP Sieve reject text sanitized before embedding in 550 response — prevents CRLF injection
description: smtp/session.rs filters the Sieve reject reason through is_ascii_graphic() || ' ' before interpolating into '550 {safe}\r\n'. This strips CR (0x0d) and LF (0x0a), preventing a malicious Sieve script from injecting additional SMTP response lines. A contributor might simplify this to just .take(200) without filtering, which would re-open the injection. The filter is correct and necessary: SMTP response lines are terminated by CRLF, and a 550 response that contains embedded CRLF would confuse the receiving MTA's parser.
